sources.blank_text: Text of a row before the impact frame, and of every row when no impact is known. Rows are blank before impact because face angle, path, attack angle and loft are defined at impact: their values at the top of the backswing are large numbers that mean nothing and draw the eye from the swing. From the impact frame on the impact values are frozen and stay to the end of the clip.
sources.rows: Card rows shown, in order, by the key of impact_parameters.panel_model.build_impact_card (which also gives labels and units). Unknown keys are refused.
sources.position: Frame edge the panel sits on: right or left.
sources.opacity: Darkening of the picture under the panel, 0 (none) to 1 (black); 0.62 is the impact card's value.
sources.font_height_divisor: Font size is the frame height divided by this (45, as the impact card).
sources.min_font_px: Smallest font size in pixels (11, as the impact card).
sources.widest_value: Text the panel width is reserved for in every row, so the panel keeps one size whatever the values are.
